outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of fluorescence micrographs only; there is no summary/average plot requiring individual data points.

The bar graphs (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean values with error bars; the underlying individual data points for each of the n=20 samples are not overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative average plot, so individual data points are not applicable.

The signal intensity bar graphs for SDH and COX staining show group means with error bars and sample sizes (n=15, 23, 26, etc.) stated in the bars, but the individual data points for each animal/sample are not plotted.

The FACS histograms display the full distribution of TMRM intensity across all individual cells in each sample rather than a single averaged summary statistic, so no additional individual data points are required.
